mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 3-month moving average signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 3-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) above their respective 6-month moving averages signals a broad-based demand expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 6-month MAs.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 12-month MA.
